rationale: The agent canceled the order without first confirming the action with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing write. It also did not clearly authenticate the user beyond looking up an email, and it failed to first inform the user whether the purchased camera was 10x zoom or pursue the requested modification path. The chosen cancellation reason (“no longer needed”) was not justified by visible evidence that 10x zoom was unavailable, and the agent provided an unsupported refund timeline (5–7 business days) not backed by tool outputs. Therefore the request was not completed in line with policy.
